zh-CN: 修正首页最终中转提示：未重试或同渠道重试时不再显示重复的最终中转。
en: Fixed the dashboard final-provider hint so it is hidden for requests without a retry or with same-provider retries.

zh-CN: 调大首页和请求记录中的正文、模型渠道及辅助信息字号，提升可读性。
en: Increased body, model/provider, and supporting text sizes on the dashboard and request history for better readability.

zh-CN: 首页最近使用记录仅在最终中转与首次尝试中转不一致时显示最终中转；同一中转重试不再重复显示渠道名。
en: Dashboard recent usage now shows the final provider only when it differs from the first attempt; same-provider retries no longer repeat the provider name.

zh-CN: 自动均衡改为按每次上游尝试记录首字耗时，纳入竞速与首字超时样本，并自动回填历史尝试数据。
自动阈值采样扩大到最多 200 条、至少 20 条，缓存更新改为 5 分钟并限制单次变化幅度；分渠竞速会避开已知不健康的中转。
en: Adaptive first-token timing now records each upstream attempt, includes race and first-token-timeout samples, and backfills historical attempt data.
Adaptive sampling now uses up to 200 samples with a 20-sample minimum, refreshes every five minutes with bounded step changes, and different-provider races avoid known unhealthy providers.

zh-CN: 请求详情弹窗支持点击周围蒙版关闭，其他确认弹窗行为保持不变。
en: Request detail dialogs can now be closed by clicking the surrounding backdrop without changing confirmation-dialog behavior.

zh-CN: 首页记录在请求仅尝试一次时不再重复显示尝试次数。
en: Dashboard records now omit the redundant attempt count when a request used only one upstream attempt.

zh-CN: 首页查看请求详情时保持在首页，并显示尝试次数和最终中转；详情会跟随请求终态停止实时计时。
en: Dashboard request details now stay on the dashboard, show attempt and final-provider information, and stop the live timer when the request reaches a terminal state.

zh-CN: 上游在 HTTP 200 流中返回但未带明确可分类 code 的失败事件，也会按上游语义失败自动重试；重试次数仍受渠道和路由组设置限制。
en: HTTP 200 stream failure events without a specific classification code are now retried as upstream semantic failures, still bounded by the provider and route-group retry settings.

zh-CN: 根据正式运行记录，将上游 HTTP 200 失败事件中的 Upstream request failed 和 WebSocket 1006 unexpected EOF 识别为临时服务错误并自动重试。
en: Based on production request records, HTTP 200 failure events containing Upstream request failed or WebSocket 1006 unexpected EOF now retry as transient server failures.

zh-CN: 将上游 HTTP 200 流中的 openai_error 识别为临时服务错误，按配置自动重试并在必要时故障转移。
en: Treat openai_error events inside HTTP 200 upstream streams as transient server failures so configured retries and failover can proceed.

zh-CN: 自动均衡的参考时限会在符合条件的新请求完成后立即刷新，并清除对应渠道与模型的旧计算缓存。
Windows 在线更新改为下载完成后先停止内置 Node 网关再启动安装器，安装器也会定向清理旧运行时进程，避免 node.exe 被占用导致覆盖失败。
en: Adaptive first-token previews now refresh as soon as a new eligible request completes, while the cached value for that provider and model is invalidated.
Windows online updates now stop the bundled Node gateway after downloading and before launching the installer, with an installer-side targeted cleanup to prevent node.exe file-lock failures.

zh-CN: 修复复用上游连接在大请求体上传期间仍被连接超时误中断的问题：请求开始写入连接后立即停止连接计时器。
普通转发和同渠竞速均覆盖复用连接路径，并新增延迟上传回归测试。
en: Fixed reused upstream connections being interrupted by the connection timeout while a large request body was still uploading: the connection timer now stops as soon as the request starts writing to the connection.
Both normal forwarding and same-provider racing cover reused connections, with regression coverage for delayed uploads.

zh-CN: 修复连接超时计时器覆盖响应头等待阶段的问题：连接建立或请求体发送后，不再因响应头较慢被误判为连接超时。
普通转发和同渠竞速路径统一使用真实网络阶段回调，保留总请求、首字和流式阶段超时；新增延迟响应头回归测试，避免误重试、误熔断及用量记录缺失。
en: Fixed the connection timeout timer from covering the response-header wait: once the connection is ready or the request body is sent, a slow response header is no longer misclassified as a connection timeout.

Normal forwarding and same-provider racing now share real network-phase callbacks while preserving total-request, first-token, and streaming timeouts; regression coverage prevents unnecessary retries, circuit penalties, and missing usage records.

zh-CN: 流式请求改用分阶段超时：首字前继续沿用切慢首字策略，首字后连续 20 秒无上游数据或连续 40 秒无有效进展时终止，总安全上限调整为 900 秒。
文本、推理、工具参数增量及上游托管工具的工作状态会刷新有效进展时限；SSE 心跳和注释不会掩盖卡死的上游流。
Responses 收到完成、未完成或失败事件后立即结束监控；Chat Completions 等待 [DONE] 后收尾，保留结束前返回的用量数据。
首字后的超时不再透明切换渠道，改为向 Responses 或 Chat 客户端返回兼容的流错误，并记录具体失败原因及渠道健康状态。
渠道设置新增总安全超时、首字后无数据超时和首字后无进展超时；仅已知旧版默认组合会一次性迁移，保留用户自定义值。
en: Streaming requests now use phase-aware timeouts: first-token handling remains unchanged, while streams stop after 20 seconds without upstream data or 40 seconds without meaningful progress, with a 900-second total safety limit.
Text, reasoning, tool-argument deltas, and managed-tool work states refresh the progress deadline; SSE heartbeats and comments no longer hide stalled upstream streams.
Responses streams stop monitoring immediately after completed, incomplete, or failed terminal events; Chat Completions waits for [DONE] so final usage remains available.

Post-first-token timeouts no longer switch providers transparently; Responses and Chat clients receive protocol-compatible stream errors while the exact failure and provider health impact are recorded.

Provider settings now expose total, post-first-token no-data, and post-first-token no-progress timeouts; only recognized legacy default combinations are migrated once, preserving user-customized values.

zh-CN: GitHub Release 精简为 6 个公开资源：两个 macOS 安装包、两个 macOS 升级包、Windows x64 安装包和升级清单。
签名文件仅在发布工作流内部临时使用，仍保留 macOS 和 Windows 在线安全升级功能。
自动均衡改用正常单次成功请求的 P75 加 2 秒，并限制在 8–15 秒；重试、竞速和故障转移请求不再污染样本。
同渠竞速支持由客户端执行的 function 和 custom 工具；上游托管工具仍使用更稳妥的非竞速路径。
请求详情新增实际切慢首字阈值、是否触发竞速及胜出尝试记录。
流式观测细分为最长上游数据块间隔、最长有效输出间隔及上游异常或超时前的最终空闲；收到正常结束事件后立即停止采样，当前路由和超时行为保持不变。
en: Reduced each GitHub Release to six public assets: two macOS installers, two macOS updater archives, the Windows x64 installer, and the updater manifest.
Signature files are now used only as temporary workflow inputs while preserving signed online updates for macOS and Windows.
Adaptive first-token limits now use the P75 of normal single-attempt successes plus 2 seconds, constrained to 8–15 seconds, while excluding retries, races, and failovers.
Same-provider racing now supports client-executed function and custom tools; managed upstream tools continue to use the safer non-racing path.
Request details now record the applied first-token limit, whether racing started, and which attempt won.

Stream observations now distinguish the longest upstream chunk gap, the longest meaningful-output gap, and the final idle period before an upstream failure or timeout; normal terminal events stop sampling immediately, and current routing and timeout behavior remains unchanged.

zh-CN: 同渠道自动重试新增 408、425、502、503、504 和 Cloudflare 520-527 临时故障状态。
明确带有 nginx、Cloudflare 或 OpenResty 网关特征的 HTML 400 会自动重试，普通 JSON 请求错误不受影响。
支持识别 HTTP 200 响应流中包装的 524、网关超时和临时连接故障，再按配置重试并故障转移。
501 等明确表示接口未实现的错误不会无效重试，Chat 接口不支持时仍使用 Responses 兼容转换。
en: Added same-provider retries for transient HTTP 408, 425, 502, 503, 504, and Cloudflare 520-527 failures.
HTML 400 responses with clear nginx, Cloudflare, or OpenResty gateway signatures are retried without affecting ordinary JSON request errors.
Wrapped 524, gateway timeout, and transient connection failures inside HTTP 200 streams are now detected before configured retries and failover.
Explicitly unsupported errors such as 501 are not retried, while unsupported Chat endpoints continue to use the Responses compatibility bridge.

zh-CN: 新增 OpenAI Chat Completions 入口，支持原生 Chat 流式与非流式请求转发。
渠道明确不支持 Chat 时自动改用 Responses 流式协议，并转换为 Chat 文本、工具调用、结束原因和 Token 用量格式。
新增渠道 Chat 能力探测和持久化记忆，限流、鉴权、超时和服务器错误不会被误判为不支持。
请求详情和上游尝试新增客户端协议、上游协议和兼容转换记录。
en: Added an OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint with native streaming and non-streaming Chat forwarding.
Channels that explicitly do not support Chat now fall back to streaming Responses, translated into Chat text, tool calls, finish reasons, and token usage.
Added persistent Chat capability detection per channel while preventing rate limits, authentication failures, timeouts, and server errors from being misclassified as unsupported.
Request details and upstream attempts now record the client protocol, upstream protocol, and compatibility conversion path.

zh-CN: 请求记录新增服务端分页、状态与渠道筛选，并支持默认开启的实时刷新。
编辑渠道时可从系统已同步的模型列表选择测试模型，新渠道默认使用 gpt-5.6-terra。
中转测评改为按每个渠道各自配置的模型执行，并在测评结果中显示实际测试模型。
en: Added server-side pagination, status and provider filters, and live refresh enabled by default for request records.
Provider editing now selects a test model from the synchronized system catalog, with gpt-5.6-terra as the default for new providers.
Provider benchmarks now use each provider's configured test model and show the actual model in benchmark results.

zh-CN: 新增桌面端启动更新检测和关于页手动检查，发现新版本后可查看说明、跟踪下载进度并重启安装。
接入 Tauri 官方更新签名校验，应用只会安装由项目私钥签名的 macOS 或 Windows 更新包。
新增需手动确认的 GitHub Release 工作流，并行构建 macOS Apple Silicon、macOS Intel 和 Windows x64 安装包。
三个平台全部成功后自动创建双语 GitHub Release、在线更新清单、签名文件和 SHA-256 校验文件。
完善 README 项目说明、作者联系方式和发版操作文档。
en: Added startup update checks and manual checks on the About page, with release details, download progress, and restart-to-install support.
Integrated official Tauri update signature verification so the app only installs macOS or Windows packages signed by the project key.
Added a manually confirmed GitHub Release workflow that builds macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Windows x64 packages in parallel.
A bilingual GitHub Release, updater manifest, signatures, and SHA-256 checksums are now created only after all three platforms build successfully.
Expanded the README project overview, author contact details, and release documentation.

zh-CN: 首页渠道概览增加正常、熔断、观察和停用状态统计，隐私模式直接隐藏渠道名称。
最近使用记录将渠道名并入推理强度行，减少纵向占用并保持隐私设置一致。
中转管理增加今日、昨日和 7 日统计范围，每个中转展示请求、平均首字、错误率、消费和缓存率。
中转管理新增默认脱敏的小眼睛开关；显示名称时点击中转可打开 Base URL 对应的官网根域名。
en: Added normal, circuit-open, observing, and disabled provider counts to the dashboard while hiding provider names entirely in privacy mode.
Moved provider names onto the reasoning-effort line in recent usage records to reduce vertical space while respecting privacy settings.
Added Today, Yesterday, and 7-day ranges to provider management, with requests, average TTFT, error rate, spend, and cache rate per provider.
Added a default-masked eye control to provider management; visible provider names now open the website origin derived from the Base URL.

zh-CN: 中转管理新增并发全测与熔断全恢复快捷操作，完成后统一刷新并汇总结果。
隐私模式匿名名称统一为渠道，并改用紧凑的眼睛按钮切换显示，同时优化最近使用记录的模型与 Token 列宽。
渠道概览新增优先级、消费高、速度快和缓存高单选排序，各项统计均跟随当前所选时间范围。
用量趋势移除独立时间选择，统一跟随使用概览的今日、昨日和 7 日范围。
en: Added concurrent test-all and reset-all circuit actions to provider management, with a single refresh and summarized results.
Standardized anonymized provider labels, replaced the privacy switch with a compact eye button, and rebalanced the model and token columns in recent usage records.
Added priority, spend, speed, and cache-rate sorting to Provider Overview, with every metric scoped to the selected time range.
Removed the separate usage-trend range selector so the chart follows the Today, Yesterday, and 7-day range selected in Usage Overview.

zh-CN: 自动均衡模式显示后端实际算法计算的参考秒数，并标明样本来源与动态变化范围。
en: Adaptive mode now displays a reference timeout calculated by the routing engine, with its sample source and dynamic behavior explained.

zh-CN: 首页首字控制改为“切慢首字”，自动均衡状态以动态时限符号展示，同时保留指定时限数据。
中转表现更名为“渠道概览”，并明确标注渠道名称隐私模式。
进行中的请求总耗时持续保留一位小数，便于观察实时变化。
en: Renamed the first-token control to better describe slow-response switching and display a dynamic marker in adaptive mode without changing the saved fixed timeout.
Renamed provider performance to Provider Overview and clearly labeled the provider-name privacy mode.
Active request durations now continuously retain one decimal place for clearer real-time updates.

zh-CN: 首页概览将实时请求置于本地请求之前，并把首字控制与运行统计收进同一紧凑区域。
减少概览区域纵向占用，为趋势图和使用记录释放更多首屏空间。
en: Moved live requests ahead of local requests and consolidated first-token controls and runtime statistics into one compact overview area.
Reduced vertical dashboard usage to expose more of the trend chart and request history above the fold.

zh-CN: 首页使用概览与运行状态合并为左栏卡片，中转表现上移并与左侧内容等高。
中转表现移除副标题，超出等高区域的内容支持卡片内滚动。
en: Merged usage and live status into a single left-column card, with provider performance moved up and matched to the left-column height.
Removed the provider performance subtitle and enabled internal scrolling for overflow content.

zh-CN: 请求模型与返回模型相同时不再重复显示，不一致时以醒目的箭头标出模型变化。
修复 Token 与缓存率在窄列中重叠的问题，并提高界面最小字号。
en: Identical requested and returned models are no longer repeated, while model changes are highlighted with a clear arrow.
Fixed token and cache-rate overlap in narrow columns and increased the minimum interface font size.

zh-CN: 用量趋势改用边界受控的平滑曲线，减少折线转折的僵硬感。
en: Usage trends now use boundary-constrained smooth curves for softer transitions between data points.

zh-CN: 用量趋势支持多指标叠加展示，默认显示全部指标，并可通过图例独立隐藏。
en: Usage trends now overlay all metrics by default and allow each series to be toggled independently from the legend.

zh-CN: 新增请求级、汇总、中转和趋势缓存命中率，按已知缓存明细加权计算。
修正部分 Token 字段缺失时趋势与中转统计漏算已知用量的问题。
en: Added weighted cache hit rates across request records, summaries, provider performance, and usage trends.
Fixed usage trends and provider statistics dropping known token usage when one token field is missing.

zh-CN: 修复 Windows 使用 CRLF 换行时版本检查误判，恢复 Windows 安装包构建。
en: Fixed false version-check failures with CRLF line endings so Windows installer builds can complete.

zh-CN: 请求记录新增推理强度与上游实际返回模型，流式、非流式和竞速请求均会采集。
首页和请求记录改为纵向展示输入、缓存和输出 Token，并压缩状态与操作列宽。
缩小首页运行中请求的中断按钮，为模型与链路信息释放更多横向空间。
en: Request history now captures reasoning effort and the model actually returned by upstream responses across streaming, non-streaming, and race requests.
Dashboard and request history now stack input, cached, and output tokens vertically while using narrower status and action columns.
Reduced the active-request interrupt button size to leave more horizontal space for model and routing details.

zh-CN: Codex 接管会识别新配置、普通配置、自定义 Provider 和已接管配置，并提供对应操作方式。
已有自定义 Provider 默认采用原位接管，只更新 API 地址和启用认证时的本地 Key，保留 Provider ID、模型与其他设置。
保留新增独立 Provider 的可选方式，并明确提示旧会话识别风险。
en: Codex takeover now distinguishes new, standard, custom-provider, and already-managed configurations and offers the appropriate action for each state.
Existing custom providers are preserved by default: only the API URL and, when enabled, the local authentication key are updated while the provider ID, model, and other settings remain unchanged.
An optional independent-provider flow remains available with a clear warning about possible session recognition impact.

zh-CN: 新增 OpenAI 兼容的 API Key 认证，可复制、重置并持久保存本地网关密钥。
首页用量趋势增加平均首字、消费金额和错误数，中转表现跟随时间范围并支持名称脱敏。
修复 Windows 后端启动路径和额外控制台窗口，提升安装版启动稳定性。
品牌区域和设置页增加 GitHub 项目入口。
新增关于页、版本一致性检查和中英文更新记录。
en: Added OpenAI-compatible API key authentication with copy, reset, and persistent local gateway credentials.
Expanded dashboard trends with average time to first token, cost, and error count; provider performance now follows the selected time range and supports masked names.
Fixed the Windows backend launch path and removed the extra console window for more reliable packaged startup.
Added GitHub project links to the brand area and settings page.
Added the About page, version consistency checks, and bilingual release notes.

zh-CN: 中转测评新增可记忆的超时时间，超时后按失败处理并继续下一次测评。
修正已完成请求被误判为客户端断开的问题，并在启动时修复历史派生数据。
完善 429、容量不足和流内失败的自动重试，并在请求记录中展示失败原因。
优化全渠道熔断后的恢复逻辑，新请求会优先探测最早熔断的中转。
en: Added a persistent benchmark timeout; timed-out runs are marked failed before continuing to the next attempt.
Fixed completed requests being misclassified as client disconnects and repaired derived historical data at startup.
Expanded automatic retries for HTTP 429, capacity, and in-stream failures, with failure reasons shown in request records.
Improved recovery when every provider is circuit-broken by probing the earliest opened circuit first.

zh-CN: 发布本地优先的 Responses API 智能路由网关与桌面管理工具。
支持 /v1/responses、/v1/responses/compact 和 /v1/models。
提供中转管理、拖拽排序、性能测评、自动重试、故障转移和熔断恢复。
提供请求记录、Token 与金额统计、首字及各阶段耗时分析。
支持 Codex 配置接管以及 macOS、Windows 桌面安装包。
en: Released the local-first Responses API smart routing gateway and desktop manager.
Added support for /v1/responses, /v1/responses/compact, and /v1/models.
Added provider management, drag sorting, benchmarking, automatic retries, failover, and circuit recovery.
Added request history, token and cost statistics, time to first token, and stage-level latency analysis.
Added Codex configuration takeover and desktop packaging for macOS and Windows.
